thread:
anna-partnerships: Quick thread to align on SI co-sell + joint announcement routing. Two asks: (1) how do we surface co-sell credit in SFDC for joint press/promo deals, and (2) what's the cadence for marketing approvals when an SI is named?

mike-sales: For SFDC crediting we already have partner_role and partner_influence fields but they're messy. Proposal: introduce co_sell_bucket = marketplace|si_direct|joint_announcement and a partner_credit_percent field so RevOps can calculate revenue splits.

leah-marketing: On announcements: marketing signoff required for any public mention of Redwood name/logo. For SI joint PRs we need legal-approved quotes + logo usage signed via our partner agreement (section 4). Timeline: plan 10 business days for co-ordinated press. If partner requests <10 days, it's expedited but needs 2x approvals (Marketing + Legal).

sam-se: From SE ops: technical case studies that mention deployment specifics (on-prem, VPC, HW bundle) must go through security review. We should flag these in the announcement intake form with a checkbox: "contains infra/config details".

anna-partnerships: Good. Propose adding two simple routing rules to the SI co-sell playbook: 
1) If deal is tagged joint_announcement -> Partnerships + Marketing + Legal auto-notified; partner must submit co-announce intake form (link) within 3 business days of deal registration.
2) If deal has hardware_bundle=true -> escalate pricing and logistics to HW partnerships and require PO lead time confirmation.

mike-sales: Also edge-case: large strategic named accounts where AE wants to keep exclusivity for a launch event. Need an approval path for AE to request partner non-public mention. Maybe add an "exclusive launch" flag that routes to VP Sales / Partnerships for review.

darin-revops: On the SFDC side I can add the co_sell_bucket and partner_credit_percent fields. Need clear definitions so data stays clean: partner_credit_percent should be set only when partner is registered and agreement attached. Otherwise default 0. Also we should capture announcement_type = press|case_study|customer_webinar.

leah-marketing: For coordinated webinars we require a speaker list and copy of slides 5 business days before. For customer case studies we need signed customer approval and model redaction checklist.

anna-partnerships: Draft intake snippet for partner co-announce (to include in portal):
```
- Deal SFDC id: <number>
- Partner name: <text>
- Announcement type: press|case_study|webinar
- Public permission obtained: yes/no
- Contains infra details: yes/no
- Requested launch date: <date>
- Contact for quotes: <name/email>
- Logo usage: attached yes/no
```

sam-se: Can we auto-block publish if contains_infra_details=yes until Security signoff? That would prevent accidental leaks.

leah-marketing: Agreed. Automation: intake -> if infra flag true -> send to security queue; marketing hold until cleared. Also add marketing_approval_status tag in SFDC.

mike-sales: For lead routing: when partner runs a co-announce campaign that generates inbound leads, those leads should be tagged source=partner_campaign and assigned to partner_claim_owner if registered. If unregistered, route to AE queue for triage. We should document claim window: 48 business hours.

anna-partnerships: Finalize playbook additions: (A) SFDC fields: co_sell_bucket, partner_credit_percent, announcement_type, marketing_approval_status. (B) Intake form template for partners. (C) Timers: partner claim window 48 business hours; announcement intake submission within 3 business days of registration; marketing review 5 business days for webinars, 10 business days for press.

darin-revops: I'll implement fields and add validation rules: partner_credit_percent required when co_sell_bucket=joint_announcement and partner_registered=true. Also add report dashboard for partnerships to see pending announcements and lead crediting.

deploybot: Created task PRT-495: "Implement SFDC fields + announcement intake + automation" assigned to darin-revops, anna-partnerships; due in 8 days.

anna-partnerships: Action items recap: anna to publish playbook addendum, darin to add SFDC fields + reports, leah to draft public templates and timelines, sam to add security checklist, mike to update AE playbook and claim SLA. Planning a pilot with 1 SI partner next month.

leah-marketing: I'll prepare two sample email templates for partners: (1) partner claim + speaker request, (2) joint-press draft.

mike-sales: OK to pilot on EMEA strategic partner PivotalWorks. I'll DM details.

anna-partnerships: Perfect. I'll circulate v0.2 and link to working doc: https://redwood.drive/partnerships/si-announcement-playbook-v0.2 (do not share externally). :thumbsup:
